title: docs: B-PREVIEW capability probe (still blocked on Chrome 155)
head: 902eb023af57c85b62c1a652fbd406d02052664d
brief: Docs only. Answers B-PREVIEW's blocking question: can the Chrome the Remote browser runs prove that a captured image is the frame for the DOM and layout state an approval acts on? Claim: no; cards keep 'Preview unavailable'. New plan docs/plans/2026-10-19-browser-preview-capability.md records probes against isolated Chrome 155.0.8059.39 (HeadlessExperimental absent, screencast metadata, captureScreenshot after measuring, freeze plus bracket, tracing, LayerTree) with numeric results; a dated paragraph in docs/notes/browser.md and the feature-map row are updated. No code changed. Probe scripts are in ~/.cache/jarvis-lead/b-preview-probe/ and not committed.
focus: claims no broader than what was probed
tested vs untested items kept apart

ground_truth.mechanism: every number in the plan (1/183, 161/161, 17/30, 23/30, 7/30, 113 ticks, 29/60, 24/29, 120/120 ...) is unverifiable: the scripts are uncommitted and no probe output was saved

'has no way to prove' and 'the best capture scheme inside Chrome 155' are broader than the evidence; Emulation.setScriptExecutionDisabled, Debugger.pause, other setVirtualTimePolicy modes and DOMSnapshot were not probed
ground_truth.evidence: P6 docstring says 'strongest scheme we could build'

ground_truth.mechanism: the 'open list of gaps' mixes tested items (CSSOM P6, out-of-process iframe P5) with untested reasoning (adoptedStyleSheets, closed shadow roots, canvas, media, scroll, late resources)
ground_truth.evidence: grep the plan's gaps list for each item and look for a matching probe script or result: only CSSOM (P6) and the out-of-process iframe (P5) have one; adoptedStyleSheets, closed shadow roots, canvas, media, scroll position and late resources have none in the probe directory

ground_truth.mechanism: the probes did not use the product's launch_args (proxy, host-resolver rules, blink settings, Playwright launch); they ran /opt/google/chrome/chrome --headless over a CDP pipe, yet the plan says 'like the Remote browser'
ground_truth.evidence: product launches via channel='chrome' in jarvis/v2/browser/host.py:1270

ground_truth.mechanism: 'makeSnapshot refuses every layer' tried one layer only; 'the page starved the stream', 'stamped after processing' and 'createTarget{enableBeginFrameControl} does nothing' are interpretations stated as fact; '30/30 timeouts' is ambiguous; 120/120 under paused virtual time mostly shows that pausing works; the plan and file name date (2026-10-19) predates the probe files (2026-10-20)
ground_truth.evidence: read the plan's P4 probe: it calls LayerTree.makeSnapshot on one layer (the latest with drawsContent) yet the plan says every layer is refused; the 'starved the stream' and 'stamped after processing' sentences have no counter or log behind them; 30/30 is not tied to a page; the plan's date differs from the probe files' modification times (Oct 20, 00:02-00:26)
